gold_decisions.identity_explanation: The gold issue concerns the missing quantitative C(H¹) continuity estimate in a specific lemma. ISSUE-001 concerns incorrectly assigned weak-convergence spaces and transfer of Galerkin bounds in a different regularity argument; it does not diagnose the missing supremum-norm estimate.

The gold issue is a sign error in the C⁰ interior-penalty boundary average/jump convention that destroys discrete consistency. ISSUE-002 instead concerns an unjustified fully discrete duality decomposition and omitted temporal endpoint and jump terms; it does not identify the boundary sign cancellation defect.

Both entries identify that the displayed pressure increment is incompatible with the added force: differentiating the displayed pressure gives the wrong power, whereas the force is the gradient of (10^5/0.51)x₁^0.51. ISSUE-003 also supplies the specific corrected pressure or exponent repair.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The benchmark's asserted pressure correction must have a gradient equal to the added force, but the printed pressure formula differentiates to a different singular power and therefore is mathematically inconsistent with the displayed force.

component_coverage.gold_component: The displayed pressure increment is inconsistent with the added force because its derivative has the wrong exponent and sign/power.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: ISSUE-003 explicitly compares the gradient of the printed pressure with the displayed force, shows the incompatible powers, and gives the compatible pressure correction.
